key_path: Sign up for free CRM (or free developer account) at hubspot.com with Google/Microsoft or email
Verify email; complete onboarding questionnaire (company, role; phone may be requested)
Agent: curl -fsSL https://api.hubapi.com/hub/cli/backend/hub-cli/latest/install.sh | sh; run 'hubspot auth login' (browser OAuth, user-scoped)
For a raw token: Settings > Integrations > Service keys (account service key) or legacy private app > copy pat-na1-... token
human_gates_notes: Super Admins can govern who connects the Agent CLI (App Governance beta). For a custom MCP client, human must create an 'MCP connector' (user-level app) in HubSpot to get OAuth credentials - no DCR.

agent_native_auth.cli_device_login: yes - Agent CLI 'hubspot auth login' (BETA) browser OAuth with auto refresh; developer CLI 'hs account auth' uses personal access key
agent_native_auth.mcp_oauth_dcr: no - mcp.hubspot.com authorization server has no registration_endpoint (verified); requires creating an MCP connector app
agent_native_auth.personal_access_tokens: yes - personal access key (CLI), service keys, private app tokens
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - scopes per service key / app
agent_native_auth.free_tier_or_sandbox: yes - free CRM, free developer account, configurable test accounts

remote.auth: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with pre-created MCP connector credentials; user-level scopes

mcp.local: Developer MCP server via HubSpot CLI 'hs mcp setup' (for building apps/CMS, not CRM data)
mcp.one_click_install: pre-built AI connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini (hubspot.com/ai-tools); none for Cursor/VS Code

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/llms.txt (200; root developers.hubspot.com/llms.txt 404) with sub-indexes per area (APIs 3686 pages)
docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - .md pages with agent index header
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - versioned specs listed in llms.txt e.g. /docs/specs/2026-09/*.json
docs_for_agents.ai_page: https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/build-with-ai/ (remote MCP, developer MCP, Agent CLI, agent context files)
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: yes - agent context files auto-added to CLI projects; skills via 'npx skills add hubspot/agent-cli-skills'

score_justification: Agent-first CLI with browser login, dry-run, and skills is excellent, but custom MCP clients need a hand-made connector app and the CLI is beta.
best_practice: An Agent CLI built for agents: self-describing --help, dry-run mode for every write, installable skills, and an install prompt to paste into the agent.
biggest_gap: Remote MCP has no DCR - outside the pre-built Claude/ChatGPT connectors, users must create an MCP connector app to get OAuth credentials.
